question.text: If the sum of the coefficients in the expansion of $(x+y)^n$ is 1024 , then the value of the greatest coefficient in the expansion is

solution.text:
Given, sum of the coefficient $=1024$
$\begin{array}{ll}\text { i.e. } & 2^n=1024=2^{10} \\ \Rightarrow & n=10\end{array}$
Since, $n$ is even, so greatest coefficient
$={ }^n C_{n / 2}={ }^{10} C_5=252$
